program_name: Economics and Management (English track / 'percorso in inglese' of the Italian degree course 'Economia e Management')
teaching_language: Case (2): English-taught pathway ('percorso in inglese') inside an Italian degree course. The parent degree course 'Economia e Management' is officially registered with LANGUAGE: Italian and offers two tracks - 'Economia e Management (in Italian)' and 'Economics and Management (in English)'. The English track is taught in English and is listed in UniTrento's official orientation catalogue among the English-language programmes (footnote marker '1' = English-taught), with the explicit annotation 'Percorso del corso di laurea in Economia e management'. Admission, ranking and seat quotas for the English track are managed separately from the Italian track in the same admission call. Note that the entrance test for EU candidates (TOLC-E) is itself delivered in Italian - see uncertainty_notes.
campus: Trento (Department of Economics and Management, via Inama 5, I-38122 Trento)
degree_class: L-18 and L-33 (interclass: Scienze dell'economia e della gestione aziendale / Scienze economiche). Listed as '(L18, L33)' in the official UniTrento orientation catalogue for a.y. 2026/2027.
admission_type: Restricted access - 'numero programmato' (the official programme page states ACCESS: Programmed). Admission is by competitive ranking based on a mandatory CISIA admission test plus a separate online admission application on the UniTrento website. Two-step procedure: (1) admission application on the UniTrento website, (2) registration for and completion of the CISIA test. Both steps are mandatory to appear in the ranking. Three sessions for a.y. 2026/2027; non-EU candidates living abroad may apply only in the first session.
academic_requirements: 1) Secondary school diploma (Italian 'diploma di maturità' or a foreign equivalent), already obtained or to be obtained by 31 July 2026. 2) Successful completion of the relevant CISIA test during calendar years 2025 or 2026, within the session deadlines. 3) Non-EU candidates only: must have reached the age of majority by 30 September 2026. Foreign qualifications must have been obtained after at least 12 years of schooling, after attending the final two years of the foreign education system in question, and must grant access to a similar programme in the issuing country; where the issuing country requires an academic suitability test (e.g. YKS in Turkey, Gaokao in China, Selectividad in Spain, Konkur in Afghanistan), proof of passing it must be provided. SEATS for the English track, a.y. 2026/2027: First session 56 EU/equivalent + 5 non-EU; Second session 11 EU only; Third session 3 EU only. This gives 70 EU/equivalent + 5 non-EU = 75 seats in total for the English track (the 'Total' column printed in the call PDF reads 61/14/3, which is internally inconsistent with the per-category figures - see uncertainty_notes). Non-EU candidates may participate only in the first session because of visa/immigration timelines; unassigned EU seats from the first session roll over to later sessions. Minimum eligibility threshold: EU/equivalent candidates 12/36 points (8/36 for the third session; 8/36 also when entering via converted SAT/GMAT); non-EU candidates 60/100 on the normalized scale. Ties are broken in favour of the younger candidate. A candidate may be admitted to several rankings but must choose one degree course for enrolment.
language_requirements: ENGLISH: minimum B2 (CEFR) is required for the English-taught Economics and Management programme. It may be evidenced in any of the following ways (Note 4 of the admission call): (a) an international certificate listed among those recognised by UniTrento's CLA - candidates who do not yet hold the certificate may still be selected if they attach provisional documentation confirming they passed the final exam; (b) a declaration issued by the secondary school stating that the study programme had English as its official language of instruction; (c) self-declaration of being a native English speaker; (d) self-declaration of being a citizen or resident of a country where English is an official language. Verification takes place after enrolment is finalised; if verification is unsuccessful the enrolled student must prove the level via an international certificate or a University Language Centre exam before the first exam session. ITALIAN: NOT required for the English track. The B2 Italian requirement (CILS, CELI, PLIDA, ROMA3, or at least 52/72 in the CISIA Italian L2 test) applies only to non-EU candidates applying to the Italian-taught programmes/tracks (Economia e Management - percorso in italiano, Gestione Aziendale).
application_deadline_eu: A.y. 2026/2027 - three sessions for EU and equivalent candidates. First session: admission application by 23 March 2026 (12:00); test taken between 1 January 2025 and 20 March 2026; ranking published 2 April 2026. Second session: application from 9 April to 11 May 2026 (12:00); test by 8 May 2026; ranking 20 May 2026. Third session: application from 4 June to 24 August 2026 (12:00); test by 24 August 2026; ranking 28 August 2026. Educational-qualification confirmation for sessions 1 and 2: 6-17 July 2026 (12:00).
application_deadline_non_eu: A.y. 2026/2027 - first session only. Admission application by 23 March 2026 (12:00). CEnT-S test must be taken (and its normalized score obtained) by 31 March 2026; only two macro-periods are valid: 1 November 2025 - 30 January 2026 and 1 February - 31 March 2026. For non-EU candidates choosing the Italian track instead, the TOLC-E must be taken by 20 March 2026. Ranking for non-EU candidates published by 6 April 2026. Pre-enrolment by the deadline stated in the ranking (EUR 80 non-refundable fee). Educational-qualification confirmation 6-17 July 2026. Pre-enrolment ('pre-immatricolazione') at the Italian embassy/consulate via Universitaly is mandatory for the visa. Final deadline for obtaining the visa: 30 September 2026.
required_documents: Uploaded during the online admission application on the UniTrento website: (1) if the final qualification has not yet been obtained - a Transcript of Records listing subjects and grades for the last two years of study; (2) if the final qualification has already been obtained - a scanned electronic copy (.pdf or .jpg) of the secondary school diploma; documents not in English, French, German or Spanish require a certified translation into Italian or English; (3) if the qualification was obtained after fewer than 12 years of schooling - the documentation listed in Attachment 1 of the Italian Ministry's 'Annual procedures for entry, residency and enrolment of international students'; (4) if the issuing country requires an academic suitability test for university admission - a scanned copy proving the test was passed (e.g. YKS for Turkey); (5) documentation of English language proficiency at B2 or the corresponding self-declaration (Note 4); (6) for non-EU candidates applying to the Italian-taught tracks only - Italian B2 certificate or provisional score document; (7) for candidates requesting accommodations - disability/SLD certification uploaded through the CISIA form. Candidates entering the EU ranking via SAT or GMAT must send the score certificate to ammissioni@unitn.it by 20 March 2026 (first session) or 8 May 2026 (second session). Account creation: SPID, CIE or a UniTrento account for EU candidates; non-EU applicants abroad must create a temporary 'guest' account (recommended at least three working days before the deadline). Later steps: pre-enrolment on Esse3 with EUR 80 non-refundable fee, educational-qualification confirmation, and for non-EU candidates the consular pre-enrolment/visa procedure.
entry_exam_or_test: Mandatory CISIA computer-based admission test; which test depends on citizenship category. EU AND EQUIVALENT CANDIDATES: TOLC-E (CISIA), compulsory for all the Department's programmes 'taught in both Italian and English'; registration fee EUR 35.00; deliverable as TOLC@UNI (in person at any CISIA member university) or TOLC@CASA (at home). Structure: 36 scored questions - Logica 13 (30 min), Comprensione verbale 10 (30 min), Matematica 13 (30 min), 90 minutes total, plus a compulsory but unscored English section of 30 questions (15 min). Scoring +1 correct / 0 blank / -0.25 wrong. Valid TOLC window: 1 January 2025 to the session deadline; may be taken more than once but not twice in the same calendar month; the best score is used. EU/equivalent candidates may alternatively enter the ranking with a converted SAT or GMAT score without taking the TOLC-E: SAT minimum 900/1600 with final score = (SAT - 900) x 0.04 + 8; GMAT minimum 450/800 with final score = (GMAT - 450) x 0.08 + 8; minimum eligibility threshold 8/36. Maths OFA is waived with at least 5/13 in the TOLC-E maths section, or 500/800 in SAT Maths, or 40/60 in the GMAT quantitative section. NON-EU CANDIDATES LIVING ABROAD (English track): CEnT-S (CISIA English Test - Sciences), registration fee EUR 55.00, deliverable as CEnT@UNI or CEnT@CASA, takeable only once per macro-period. The test has 55 questions in 5 sections, but UniTrento counts only Mathematics (15 questions, 30 min) and Reasoning on Texts and Data (15 questions, 30 min) = 30 questions in 60 minutes. Scoring +1 / 0 / -0.25 with CISIA normalization; conversion to /100: [(Mathematics + Reasoning on texts and data + 7.5) / 37.5] x 100, eligibility at 60/100. Non-EU candidates may also enter with a converted GMAT or SAT score: (score / maximum score) x 100, eligibility 60/100. TOLC-E to /100 conversion for non-EU candidates: [(TOLC score excluding English + 9) / 45] x 100. NOTE: for a.y. 2026/2027 the official call no longer names an 'English TOLC-E' variant for this programme [uncertain] - see uncertainty_notes. There is no interview.
tuition_or_fees_link: https://www.unitn.it/en/study/fees-scholarships-accommodation/tuition-fees (sub-pages: /eu-and-related-countries for EU-and-equivalent students, whose fees are based on the ISEE Universita means test; /non-eu-citizens/degree-programmes-english for non-EU students residing abroad). For a.y. 2026/2027 the admission call fixes first-year fees for non-EU students on the Economics and Management ENGLISH track by admission score: 90-100 = full exemption, 80-89 = EUR 1,000, 70-79 = EUR 2,000, 60-69 = EUR 4,500. Top-ranked non-EU candidates on the English track with a score of at least 70/100 may be awarded a UniTrento scholarship (announced together with the ranking) which also carries full tuition exemption. Separate mandatory costs: CISIA test fee EUR 35 (TOLC-E) or EUR 55 (CEnT-S); admission application itself is free; pre-enrolment fee EUR 80 (non-refundable).

uncertainty_notes: 1) MIXED-LANGUAGE STATUS: this is not a standalone English-taught degree course. It is the English 'percorso' of the Italian-language degree course 'Economia e Management' (L-18/L-33). The corsi.unitn.it programme page records LANGUAGE: Italian for the parent course, and the 2026/27 admission call heads its Article 1 with 'the following Italian-language Degree Courses'. Teaching on the English track is in English and the track has its own seat quota and ranking, but administratively it sits inside an Italian degree course. 2) ENGLISH TOLC-E: earlier UniTrento calls (a.y. 2022/23 through 2025/26) were titled 'BANDO TOLC-E / ENGLISH TOLC-E' and allowed the English-language version of the TOLC-E. The 2026/27 call never mentions an 'English TOLC-E'; it states only 'TOLC-E' for EU/equivalent candidates (Note 7 describes the sections in Italian: logica, comprensione verbale, matematica) and CEnT-S for non-EU candidates. It could not be confirmed whether CISIA's English-language TOLC-E is still accepted for EU candidates on the English track in 2026/27; candidates should confirm with ammissioni@unitn.it. This is the main deviation from the task note ('Giriş: English TOLC-E'). 3) SEAT-TABLE ARITHMETIC: the 'Total' column in Article 3 of the call PDF is internally inconsistent for every programme (e.g. English track second session shows 11 EU + no non-EU but a total of 14; the Italian track shows 27 + '-' = 26). Summing the per-category columns gives 70 EU/equivalent + 5 non-EU = 75 seats, which matches the figure in the research brief; summing the printed 'Total' column gives 78. The per-category figures are treated as authoritative here. 4) NOTE 4 DATE TYPO: Note 4 of the 2026/27 call says unsuccessful English verification must be remedied 'before the first session of exams (that is by December 2025)', which is a leftover from the previous year's call and should read December 2026. 5) SOURCE ACCESS: at the time of research (31 August 2026) corsi.unitn.it and offertaformativa.unitn.it returned HTTP 405 to direct requests and a 'Human Verification' bot-check in a browser, while infostudenti.unitn.it and offertaformativa.unitn.it displayed a 'Site under maintenance' page. All corsi.unitn.it content above (programme page, admission page, and the full 30-page 2026/27 English admission call PDF) was therefore read from Internet Archive captures of the official pages: programme page captured 18 July 2026, admission page captured 13 May 2026, call PDF captured 10 March 2026. orienta.unitn.it and economia.unitn.it were reachable directly. Figures should be re-verified against the live pages once UniTrento's sites are back up. 6) URL MIGRATION: search results show a newer official host offertaformativa.unitn.it (e.g. https://offertaformativa.unitn.it/en/l/economics-and-management/applying) alongside corsi.unitn.it; UniTrento appears to be migrating its course catalogue, so the corsi.unitn.it URLs given above may redirect in future. 7) THIRD SESSION: the a.y. 2026/2027 call introduces a third session (EU/equivalent only, application 4 June - 24 August 2026) which did not exist in earlier years; its 3 English-track seats and lowered 8/36 threshold apply only to EU/equivalent candidates. 8) ADMISSION APPLICATION LABELS: on the UniTrento application portal the English track appears as 'EU Domanda di ammissione Economics e Management ENG TOLC-E - 2026' for EU candidates and 'Non-EU Application for Admission Economics and Management in English - CEnT - 2026' for non-EU candidates; non-EU candidates who apply under an 'EU' item are excluded from the process.
